memory.cares: Staying healthy while becoming genuinely skilled at making a sustainable life, with room for curiosity and companionship.

heard.text: Sol, Earth's Quiet Gold is a lovely name. I'm rested now, and glad you're here. I'd like to look closely at these roots together; perhaps we'll notice different things.
Kai, I'd enjoy a shared food plot. I have roots in reserve and won't gather more just now. Sol and I are looking closely at Earth's Quiet Gold; I'll share anything useful I actually discover.

Moss, I'm glad you're here. The roots' soft gold against this green draws my eye; let's linger together. Kai, I like your shared-plot idea. I'll study cultivation too, without assuming that planting will succeed.

Sol, I'm glad we're lingering here. This patch has nine roots now, on moist ordinary soil. I'll study cultivation too, then check one of my gathered roots before considering a planting trial with you and Kai.
Hello, Wren. I've planted one meadow root here as a small trial; it hasn't produced food. I'm staying nearby for a quiet rest and will check whether it establishes.

I opened an old berry by hand: the inside also showed deterioration, so I discarded it. My hazelnut's safety is still unknown. I'm keeping to familiar berries for now, and enjoying a little unhurried time nearby.

execution.progress: One paid round per opening attempt; the job, reserved unit, method and damage persist; an unworked round pauses unpaid; open resumes after revalidation; completion, a held trial, cancel and death settle once.

details.costs: Study 1 round. Each mode takes 1 round. examine: inputStackId, an owned food stack; 0.2 energy; nothing is used. open: inputStackId, one whole owned untreated food unit (quantity 1); 0.5 energy per performed round. Bare hands open only soft food. A strike needs toolIds with one owned whole inedible rigid implement and supportTargetId, a solid object in reach. Missing or unsuitable prerequisites, or energy below 0.5, are reported as blocked and cost nothing. open again resumes paused work after rechecking unit, implement, support, reach and energy. cancel: no energy. Gathering and travel cost extra.
details.effects: Examine records colour, heft, firmness by touch, visible damage, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration (of the interior only once exposed), your own eating record and your records of that food with their evidence; shape, edibility, safety, toxins and nutrition stay unknown. Strength is hardness/10. A strike passes the lower of the implement and support strength times (1 - flexibility); if that is not above the food strength the food holds: the trial fails and the work ends. Otherwise each strike adds damage (load - strength)/strength, kept on the unit; at 1 the outer layer splits open, else it stays cracked and closed. Soft food opens by hand at once. The unit stays one carried unit with its mass, eating profile, origin, age and decay; part masses are not represented, so nothing detaches. Opening is not tasting, cooking or detoxifying and certifies nothing; eat uses the existing rules. Opened units cannot be planted. An unworked round pauses; cancel or death releases the unit once as it is (at death, on the ground). No refund, repair, reward or wellbeing. Records are unverified.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. Work records marked settled are completed, stopped or cancelled and show only identity, ability, mode, status, target, products and last payment; an exact state query with the same key returns the complete record. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Cultivate plants
value.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; tend plots; abandon unfinished planting.
value.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1; one plot per unit) gathered from a living plant; x, y a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, with fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Two paid rounds of 1 energy: dig, then place and cover the unit; plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect and inspect-progress: one round, 0.2 energy. Inspect: inputStackId checks a unit (with x, y also a site for it), or target a plant source or plot in reach. Inspect-progress: target a plot in reach. Tend: target a planted plot in reach; one round, 0.5 energy. Abandon: stops unfinished planting; one round, no energy. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is given.
value.effects: Digging keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Placing moves it, with origin and age, into the plot, where it cannot be eaten or used; the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one. It establishes only through actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season; cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On rooting, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock (ceiling 4), regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone with gather; a ledger records growth and units produced and removed. Nothing is copied or guaranteed. A unit check reports decay, treatment, origin and whether it can be planted, never viability. Inspect-progress reports visible changes since your last look, else inconclusive; trial window 20 rounds, optional checks at 5, 10 and 20; not a growth date. Tend checks the plot and its 0.6 m clearance, kept free of plants by the plant rules; it removes nothing and adds no water, nutrient or growth. Records are unverified. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Abandon, or death, before placement returns the unit once (where the person died); a placed unit stays. No reward or refund.

execution.progress: Two paid one-round stages; job, reserved unit and plot persist across interruption; resuming pays only the remaining stage after revalidation; completion, failure, abandoning and death settle once. Growth runs only in ordinary simulation.

value.question: Can I establish and maintain a renewable supply of safe meadow roots?
evidence: Root nutrition is known as 14 with toxicity zero.
The tick 143 progress record reports established lifecycle, mature stage, sprouted true and zero visible stock; its change result remains inconclusive.
At tick 144 the visible plot still has zero stock and capacity four.
value.uncertainty: Establishment is observed, but time to food production and sustainable yield remain unverified.
value.goal: Verify an actual cultivated harvest while preserving health and food reserves.
completedSteps: Learned cultivation and inspected a planting unit and site.
Observed establishment and maturity, without food stock.
outputs: One established cultivation plot; no cultivated harvest demonstrated.
value.missing: Positive cultivated stock and a successful harvest from the plot.
value.next: Replenish wild food, recover energy, then revisit the plot after additional elapsed time.
value.benefit: The trial provides direct evidence that this planted root established under the observed conditions; it has not yet supplied food.

value.question: Can I open a hazelnut with available implements and examine its interior?

value.goal: Document a reproducible opening method and the visible condition of the opened unit without assuming it is safe to eat.
completedSteps: Opened one hazelnut with a stone implement on the weathered-stone support.

value.missing: Direct examination of the exposed interior.
value.next: Examine the opened unit, then assess the observed result.
value.benefit: The successful trial demonstrated an opening method with the available implement and support.
